text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. In accordance with Section 33 of the Planning Act and the former City of Toronto Municipal Code Ch. 363, Article II “Demolition Control”, the application for the demolition of a dwelling at 2590 Midland Avenue is referred to the Scarborough Community Council to refuse or to grant the application as a building permit has not been issued for a replacement building. If the Scarborough Community Council grants issuance of the demolition permit, it may impose conditions if any, to be attached to the demolition permit.
